dialogue.text: Hello. I'm Dr. Agent, and I'll be looking into these behavioral concerns with you today. To get started, when did these issues at school and at home first begin?
Hi Dr. Agent. My mom says I'm good at home, but school is different because my teacher keeps trying to tell me what to do. I don't see why I have to listen to her rules when she's not the boss of me.
I see; it sounds like you feel frustrated with the rules at school. How often do you find yourself arguing with your teacher, and do you feel like you lose your temper during those times?
It’s not really arguing, I just tell her she can't make me do stuff I don't want to do. I don't get mad or yell, I just don't think it's fair that she thinks she can boss me around all day.

That’s helpful to know. Have there been any times recently where you've refused to do chores or follow rules at home, or do you ever feel the need to get back at someone who you think is being unfair?

Patient: No, I like helping my mom with my little sister and doing stuff around the house. I don't try to get back at people; I just don't like it when teachers try to force me to do things that aren't their business.

I appreciate your honesty about how you feel at school. Have you ever gotten into trouble for fighting with other kids, hurting animals, or damaging things that aren't yours? 

REQUEST TEST

It's mostly just my teacher and the gym coach when they try to force me into activities I don't want to do. I don't have these problems with my parents or other adults who don't act so bossy.

It's helpful to understand that this mostly happens with authority figures at school. Do you ever feel like you're easily annoyed by others, or do you find yourself feeling resentful about the rules you have to follow there?

I don't really get annoyed by other kids, but it is definitely annoying when the teacher makes up rules for no reason. It’s not that I’m mad, I just don't think it's right for them to act like they own me.

I understand how that could be frustrating for you. Since this started a few months ago, have your grades or your friendships at school been affected by these conflicts? Also, do you ever find yourself blaming the teacher for the mistakes you make?

My grades are still good because I'm smart and my friends all like me, so that's not a problem. I don't blame her for my mistakes, but it's definitely her fault when we have a problem because she's the one trying to control everything.

It’s probably been about six or seven months since she started being so bossy. I’ve felt this way since the middle of the school year when the rules started getting really annoying.

I don't really get angry or lose my temper, because I'm just standing up for myself. I don't feel like an angry person; I just stay firm when people try to tell me what to do for no reason.
